text: I think you'll enjoy this Tequila Lime Chicken recipe from Applebee's, given your past fondness for fresh ginger and Chinese-inspired dishes. Although this recipe doesn't explicitly feature ginger, it does have a hint of it in the form of a small amount of grated ginger. The combination of tequila, lime juice, and spices will likely appeal to your taste preferences, and the dish's protein content aligns with your observed pattern of liking recipes with higher protein levels.
